reviewed_by: Claude (butler-recovery-harness-child bug loop); selection reviewed against the diff by the implementing agent, root cause independently validated by a separate subagent
reason: #1140 made Butler's subagents run on a provider model (chat_subagents subagents.runtime_model guard; settings refuse a harness child), but a configuration saved before it can still name a harness child. ButlerRecoveryAgent then offered subagent tools whose every start was refused, failing a harness recovery. butler_recovery.py now leaves delegation off for a saved harness child, records butler.recovery.harness_subagent_skipped, and sets allow_subagents only when a usable child runtime exists. tests/v3/test_butler_concurrent_recovery.py's runtime matrix (red on main since #1140) now expects no delegation for a harness child; test_butler_subagents and test_butler_recovery cover the touched paths.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright change; docs/design/nebula-settings-assistant.md only corrects the background-check note. The behaviour needs a Butler recovery case with a pre-#1140 harness child config, which the synthetic recovery suite reproduces; it was not driven on the staging Core. PostgreSQL variants skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL.
